system.flavor: 40mm capture net, WA -5, range 25 m: 1D6 and a 2 m net around the target.
system.notes:
THE BOOK: Home of the Brave p.87, "Net: This capture round shoots a small (2m) net that wraps around the target. It has a Weapon Accuracy of -5, an effective range of 25 meters, and does 1D6 damage" (from the mass of the net weights).

MODEL: the entanglement is by hand.

MODEL: the round has no blast radius of its own, so blastRadius is 0.5 m - the module's area flow then reaches the target's own square and nothing beyond it (a 0 would fall back to the 5 m grenade row of CP2020 p.99).
